title: "05_GSEA_analysis_DU_GH"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-13"

# Original GSEA workflow developed by: Dogukan Hazar Ulgen
# Adapted and generalized for this repository by: Natalia K. M. Schilder

############################################################
# 05_GSEA_analysis.R
#
# Purpose:
#   Perform Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) using the
#   complete edgeR differential-expression results.
#
# Input:
#   Complete edgeR results from 02_DEG_analysis.R
#
# Important:
#   GSEA uses ALL tested genes. Do not pre-filter the input
#   using a DEG log2FC or FDR cutoff.
############################################################


# ==========================================================
# 1. USER SETTINGS
# ==========================================================

# CHANGE THIS to your own project directory
project_dir <- "YOUR/PROJECT/DIRECTORY/HERE"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Input differential-expression table
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Use the COMPLETE edgeR results, not the filtered DEG table.
deg_results_file <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Results",
  "DGEA",
  "DEG_lists",
  "YOUR_CUTOFF_FOLDER",
  "all_tested_genes_ES_vs_CTL.csv"
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Organism annotation
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# This version is configured for mouse.
OrgDb <- org.Mm.eg.db


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# GO ontology
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# Options:
#   "BP" = Biological Process
#   "MF" = Molecular Function
#   "CC" = Cellular Component
#   "ALL" = all GO ontologies
ontology <- "BP"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# RANKING METHOD
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# GSEA requires one ranked value for every tested gene.
#
# Options:
#
#   "PValue"
#       -log10(raw p-value) * sign(log2FC)
#
#   "FDR"
#       -log10(BH-adjusted FDR) * sign(log2FC)
#
#
ranking_method <- "PValue"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Multiple-testing correction for GSEA
# ----------------------------------------------------------

p_adjust_method <- "BH"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# GSEA calculation cutoff
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# clusterProfiler only retains pathways below this p-value
# in the returned GSEA object.
#
# A relatively permissive value can be used here so that
# pathways remain available for later inspection.
#
gsea_pvalue_cutoff <- 0.5


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Final enrichment significance threshold
# ----------------------------------------------------------

# This is the threshold used when defining/reporting
# significant enriched pathways.
#
gsea_FDR_cutoff <- 0.10


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Number of permutations
# ----------------------------------------------------------

n_permutations <- 10000


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Number of pathways shown in summary plots
# ----------------------------------------------------------

show_categories <- 15


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Output directory
# ----------------------------------------------------------

output_dir <- file.path(
  project_dir,
  "Results",
  "GSEA"
)


# ==========================================================
# 2. LOAD PACKAGES
# ==========================================================

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)


# ==========================================================
# 3. CHECK INPUTS
# ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists(project_dir)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Project directory does not exist:\n",
      project_dir
    )
  )
}


if (!file.exists(deg_results_file)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Complete DEG result file not found:\n",
      deg_results_file
    )
  )
}


dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 4. LOAD COMPLETE edgeR RESULTS
# ==========================================================

DE <- read.csv(
  deg_results_file,
  check.names = FALSE
)


required_columns <- c(
  "Gene",
  "logFC",
  "PValue",
  "FDR"
)


missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(DE)
)


if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Required column(s) missing:\n",
      paste(
        missing_columns,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


message(
  "Genes available for GSEA: ",
  nrow(DE)
)


# ==========================================================
# 5. CREATE GSEA RANKING STATISTIC
# ==========================================================

# Avoid log10(0) if values have been rounded to zero.
smallest_positive_p <- min(
  DE$PValue[DE$PValue > 0],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

smallest_positive_fdr <- min(
  DE$FDR[DE$FDR > 0],
  na.rm = TRUE
)


DE$PValue_for_rank <- ifelse(
  DE$PValue <= 0,
  smallest_positive_p,
  DE$PValue
)


DE$FDR_for_rank <- ifelse(
  DE$FDR <= 0,
  smallest_positive_fdr,
  DE$FDR
)


if (ranking_method == "PValue") {

  DE$rank_score <-
    -log10(DE$PValue_for_rank) *
    sign(DE$logFC)

} else if (ranking_method == "FDR") {

  DE$rank_score <-
    -log10(DE$FDR_for_rank) *
    sign(DE$logFC)

} else {

  stop(
    "ranking_method must be either 'PValue' or 'FDR'."
  )
}


# Remove genes without usable ranking values.
DE_ranked <- DE %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Gene),
    !is.na(rank_score),
    is.finite(rank_score)
  )


# ==========================================================
# 6. CONVERT GENE SYMBOLS TO ENTREZ IDS
# ==========================================================

gene_conversion <- bitr(
  DE_ranked$Gene,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = OrgDb
)


DE_ranked <- DE_ranked %>%
  inner_join(
    gene_conversion,
    by = c("Gene" = "SYMBOL")
  )


# If multiple symbols/IDs produce duplicate Entrez IDs,
# retain the entry with the largest absolute ranking score.
DE_ranked <- DE_ranked %>%
  arrange(
    desc(abs(rank_score))
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    ENTREZID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


# ==========================================================
# 7. CREATE RANKED GENE LIST
# ==========================================================

gene_list <- DE_ranked$rank_score

names(gene_list) <- DE_ranked$ENTREZID


gene_list <- sort(
  gene_list,
  decreasing = TRUE
)


# GSEA requires a ranked list containing both positive
# and negative values.
if (!any(gene_list > 0) ||
    !any(gene_list < 0)) {

  warning(
    paste0(
      "The ranked gene list does not contain both positive ",
      "and negative values."
    )
  )
}


message(
  "Genes entering GSEA after Entrez conversion: ",
  length(gene_list)
)


# ==========================================================
# 8. RUN GO GSEA
# ==========================================================

gsea_result <- gseGO(
  geneList = gene_list,
  OrgDb = OrgDb,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = ontology,
  pvalueCutoff = gsea_pvalue_cutoff,
  pAdjustMethod = p_adjust_method,
  nPermSimple = n_permutations,
  verbose = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 9. SAVE COMPLETE GSEA RESULTS
# ==========================================================

gsea_table <- as.data.frame(
  gsea_result
)


write.csv(
  gsea_table,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      "GSEA_GO_",
      ontology,
      "_all_results.csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 10. SAVE SIGNIFICANT GSEA RESULTS
# ==========================================================

gsea_significant <- gsea_table %>%
  filter(
    p.adjust < gsea_FDR_cutoff
  )


write.csv(
  gsea_significant,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      "GSEA_GO_",
      ontology,
      "_FDR_",
      gsea_FDR_cutoff,
      ".csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


message(
  "Significant pathways at FDR < ",
  gsea_FDR_cutoff,
  ": ",
  nrow(gsea_significant)
)


# ==========================================================
# 11. DOT PLOT
# ==========================================================

if (nrow(gsea_table) > 0) {

  p_dot <- clusterProfiler::dotplot(
    gsea_result,
    showCategory = show_categories,
    x = "NES",
    color = "p.adjust"
  ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "GSEA – GO ",
        ontology
      )
    )


  print(
    p_dot
  )


  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "GSEA_dotplot_GO_",
        ontology,
        ".pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = p_dot,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
}


# ==========================================================
# 12. ACTIVATED / SUPPRESSED PATHWAY PLOT
# ==========================================================

if (nrow(gsea_table) > 0) {

  p_direction <- clusterProfiler::dotplot(
    gsea_result,
    showCategory = show_categories,
    split = ".sign",
    x = "NES"
  ) +
    facet_grid(
      . ~ .sign
    )


  print(
    p_direction
  )


  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        "GSEA_activated_suppressed_GO_",
        ontology,
        ".pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = p_direction,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
}


# ==========================================================
# 13. SAVE RANKED GENE LIST
# ==========================================================

ranked_gene_table <- data.frame(
  ENTREZID = names(gene_list),
  Rank_score = as.numeric(gene_list)
)


write.csv(
  ranked_gene_table,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      "GSEA_ranked_gene_list_",
      ranking_method,
      ".csv"
    )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 14. SAVE ANALYSIS SETTINGS
# ==========================================================

gsea_settings <- data.frame(

  Setting = c(
    "Ontology",
    "Ranking method",
    "Ranking formula",
    "GSEA p-value cutoff",
    "Final FDR cutoff",
    "P-value adjustment",
    "Permutations"
  ),

  Value = c(
    ontology,
    ranking_method,

    ifelse(
      ranking_method == "PValue",
      "-log10(PValue) * sign(logFC)",
      "-log10(FDR) * sign(logFC)"
    ),

    gsea_pvalue_cutoff,
    gsea_FDR_cutoff,
    p_adjust_method,
    n_permutations
  )
)


write.csv(
  gsea_settings,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "GSEA_analysis_settings.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 15. SAVE SESSION INFORMATION
# ==========================================================

capture.output(
  sessionInfo(),
  file = file.path(
    output_dir,
    "sessionInfo_05_GSEA_analysis.txt"
  )
)


message(
  "GSEA analysis completed."
)
